name: Night Raids
description: At nightfall, by chance, waves of Vukah gather outside a base where players are and march on its flame altar, at the players' level. A warning first, the raiders left on screen, a reward when you repel them; survivors flee at dawn. With Raiders break walls on, a raider held up by a wall or a closed gate breaks through it. Installed switched off; once on, it is still off in every world until you switch it on there (raids.world on). Host or dedicated server; players who join need nothing.

settings.label: Raids in the world you are in
settings.help: Kept with each world; every world starts off. Switch it while that world is loaded (or type raids.world on).

settings.label: Raid strength
settings.help: How often and how hard raids come, in one choice. A preset decides the settings it greys out below; they keep showing your own values, which My own settings uses again.

options.label: Gentle: 25% a night, 1 wave of 3, 5 levels below, 120 s warning, a quiet night after, runes and furs
Standard: 35% a night, 2 waves of 4 at your level, 60 s apart, 60 s warning, runes and furs
Hard: 50% a night, 3 waves of 6, 3 levels above, 45 s apart, boss wave, 45 s warning, rare weapon

settings.label: Raids come at (hour)
settings.help: Rolled once per night, when the clock passes this hour.

settings.label: Raiders per wave
settings.help: At most 24 are alive at once.

settings.label: Seconds between waves
settings.help: Sooner when every raider of a wave is dead.

options.label: Easy: 5 levels below the strongest player at the base

settings.label: Boss wave
settings.help: The last wave brings a Vukah brawler, a mini-boss with a boss bar (see Only creatures you are ready for).

settings.label: Raiders attack
settings.help: Who a raider goes for when one is near it (25 m). Otherwise it marches on the flame altar.

settings.label: Only creatures you are ready for
settings.help: The Vukah brawler (boss wave) waits until the strongest player at the base is level 5; your own templates wait for their @level.

settings.label: My own templates
settings.help: Template GUIDs separated by commas; GUID@12 comes from player level 12. Untested ones may spawn asleep.

settings.label: Raiders break walls
settings.help: A raider held up by a wall or a closed gate on its way to the flame altar breaks through it: cracks first, then a hole that stays (saved with the world, like mining). Straw and wood go quickly, stone takes a group about half a minute, metal mostly holds. Never the ground, and never the world's own ruins (a hole next to a ruin is smaller). Needs EMF 0.6.14 or newer.

settings.label: Wall strength (x hits)
settings.help: How many hits walls and gates take, times the normal. At 1 a raider hits like an iron pickaxe: a wood wall cracks at the first hit and breaks at the second or third, planks take 5, stone about 20, a gate about 6. At 3 every one takes three times as many. Several raiders at one wall, and harder raids, hit harder.

settings.label: Broken blocks drop items
settings.help: What a pickaxe would give for the broken blocks, and a broken gate's own item, at the hole.

settings.label: Raiders also break walls of terrain blocks
settings.help: Walls of Stone, Granite, Field Stones, dirt, sand or road blocks are terrain to the game. With this on, raiders break those too, as long as a player placed them (where the world had no ground). The world's own ground, hills and ruins are never touched. Needs EMF 0.6.19 or newer.

options.label: The one with the most players
Any base with players, at random

settings.label: Base radius (m)
settings.help: Around the flame altar: players inside are at the base; raiders gather 5-25 m beyond it (40-60 m from the altar at least), never inside.

options.label: Runes and furs, one each per raider slain
Runes, furs and a rare weapon at your level
